parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the task. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The task ID. The globally unique identifier of the task.

parameters.name: RolloutConfig
parameters.description: The number of jobs pushed per minute in the task. Valid values: 50 to 1000.

parameters.name: TimeoutConfig
parameters.description:
The timeout period for job execution in the task.

For more information, see the "TimeoutConfig definition" section below.
